analysis.reasonEn: The wait-and-see stance has been maintained for 3 consecutive trading days. RSI is consolidating around the 50 level, showing no clear direction. MACD histogram shows improvement but the rate of increase has slowed compared to before. Volume is also subdued at 0.56x the 5-day average, indicating insufficient momentum for a trend change. The sideways range between the 245,000 support and 267,000 resistance levels persists.
